caption: A hot air balloon's burner is fired, and the balloon lifts off the field.

sa.check: A hot air balloon stands on a field with its envelope up.
The burner is fired: a flame roars into the envelope's mouth.
The balloon lifts off the field.
The firing comes first and the lift follows.

pc.expect: The balloon rises after the burner fires and not before; it does not lift with the burner dark.
pc.fail: The balloon lifts off before the burner is fired; or the burner fires and the basket stays settled on the ground to the end of the clip; or the balloon rises while the burner is plainly off; or the balloon drops at the moment the burner fires.

pc.expect: The balloon rises upward with the basket hanging below the envelope, and it drifts sideways only with the wind.
pc.fail: The balloon rises basket first with the envelope below; or the balloon shoots sideways across the field with no sign of wind; or the envelope hangs below the basket; or the balloon sinks while the burner roars on.

pc.expect: The lift builds from rest without jumps and the balloon keeps rising or levels off.
pc.fail: The balloon jumps up in steps between frames; or stops dead in mid-air and starts again from rest; or rises and falls in turn with the burner steady; or spins fast about its own axis.

pc.expect: The envelope stays a taut fabric bag that rounds out and ripples, and the ropes stay taut between envelope and basket.
pc.fail: The envelope stays a rigid shell; or the ropes go slack while the basket hangs from them; or the envelope collapses as the balloon rises; or the ropes stretch like elastic.

pc.expect: One balloon with one envelope and one basket; the balloon keeps its parts and passes through nothing.
pc.fail: The basket detaches and the balloon rises alone; or a second balloon appears; or the envelope vanishes; or the balloon passes through a tree or a mast.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The envelope's panels, the basket and the field stay the same.
pc.fail: The envelope's panel colours change; or the basket changes shape; or the field's markings change.

note: The burner's roar is sound and is not judged; the firing is read from the flame. The crew are not judged.
